Tool or resource page named by the toolkit

description: Coastal Change Hazards Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS Center for Integrated Data Analytics; USGS Coastal and Marine Geology Program. Access coastal change science and data organized into three themes: The Coastal Vulnerability Index (CVI) (available under the sea level rise theme) seeks to objectively determine the relative risks due to future sea level rise for the United States' ocean coasts. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Landslides. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
